title: MRAM keeps data safe in extreme conditions
summary: Everspin Technologies’ PERSYST xSPI STT-MRAM, now available through DigiKey, delivers a high-reliability, non-volatile memory solution designed for aerospace, defense, and mission-critical embedded systems. body_markdown:
Everspin Technologies’ PERSYST xSPI STT-MRAM, now available through DigiKey, delivers a high-reliability, non-volatile memory solution designed for aerospace, defense, and mission-critical embedded systems. Built on advanced spin-transfer torque MRAM technology, it offers ultra-fast access speeds, virtually unlimited endurance, and eliminates the need for batteries, refresh cycles, or wear leveling.


Read the Electronic Specifier article for more on this product: https://www.electronicspecifier.com/press-releases/mram-keeps-data-safe-in-extreme-conditions/
